summary: VolitionRx Ltd filed an 8-K to disclose a securities purchase agreement for a registered direct offering of 2,960,000 shares of common stock and warrants to purchase up to 1,480,000 shares of common stock, priced at $1.55 per share and accompanying warrant. Net proceeds are approximately $4.1 million. The warrants have a five-year term, exercise price of $1.55, and include blocker provisions at 4.99%/9.99% beneficial ownership. Pre-funded warrants were authorized but not sold. This is a capital-raise event with no strategic special situation such as M&A, activist campaign, or restructuring. Watch for dilution impact and stock price reaction post-offering.
